__WTRL_ONLINE_HELP__.version_note: This document is an experimental LLM-readable online help representation.
__WTRL_ONLINE_HELP__.summary: Command-line toolkit for Waterloo docstrings, JSON artifacts, HTML rendering, example embedding, and MCP packaging.

subcommands.name: validate
subcommands.usage: waterlint validate [--basedir DIR] [--fail-on-warning] [--out-diag PATH] [--out-diag-json PATH] [--obj QUALNAME | --in FILE] [--debug] [--ignore RULES]
